_comment: Clock-gating and logic-depth units for RI's RCU RTL (tools/check-cg.py, tools/check-ngd.py; docs/rtl-coding-style.md, 'Local clock gating' and 'Logic depth'). Each bench is the module's value-model bench (test/rcu/*_tb.cpp) in its --cg mode, built by test/rcu/cg-build.sh at the unit's parameters: idle is reset and then no work, medium work on about a third of the cycles, high work every cycle. rcu_bank_slice_r32 is the reduced unit for loops (ROWS 32; RA-32 (2)); rcu_bank_slice is the full-size slice, M3's exit (Partition tab). One slice stands for all 32: K and J change only its wiring. {dir} is the unit's bench build directory, {scenario} and {vcd} the run's.
